disclaimer: This is a simulated documentation-readiness workflow. It does not reproduce a payer policy, determine coverage, or provide clinical guidance.
indication_text: Stable, symptomatic chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction in sinus rhythm with an elevated resting heart rate while receiving a maximally tolerated beta-blocker dose or when beta-blocker therapy is contraindicated.

requirements.title: Requested medication documented
requirements.policy_text: The encounter documents a decided plan to start ivabradine.
requirements.provenance_note: This check confirms that the synthetic encounter contains the requested medication. It is a CardioFlow workflow rule, not an FDA indication or payer requirement.

requirements.title: Cardiology encounter
requirements.provenance_note: The current FDA label and the cited guideline do not require a cardiology prescriber. CardioFlow uses this rule to demonstrate evaluation of encounter context.

requirements.title: Chronic HFrEF diagnosis
requirements.policy_text: The approved diagnosis is stable, symptomatic chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
requirements.provenance_note: The FDA prescribing information identifies stable, symptomatic chronic heart failure with reduced left ventricular ejection fraction for the adult indication.

requirements.title: LVEF at or below 35% within 12 months
requirements.policy_text: The approved LVEF is 35% or less and was measured within 365 days before the encounter.
requirements.provenance_note: The FDA prescribing information supports the LVEF threshold. The 365-day documentation window is a CardioFlow demo rule and is not stated in that indication.

criterion_sources.title: CORLANOR (ivabradine) prescribing information
criterion_sources.organization: U.S. National Library of Medicine DailyMed

requirements.title: NYHA class II or III
requirements.policy_text: The approved functional class is NYHA class II or III.
requirements.provenance_note: The 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA guideline recommendation for ivabradine applies to symptomatic NYHA class II to III stable chronic HFrEF.

criterion_sources.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure

requirements.title: Sinus rhythm documented
requirements.policy_text: The encounter documents sinus rhythm by ECG or monitor and contains no approved atrial fibrillation or flutter history.
requirements.provenance_note: The FDA prescribing information supports sinus rhythm. Requiring ECG or monitor documentation from this encounter and treating any approved atrial fibrillation or flutter history as review-required are CardioFlow demo constraints.

requirements.title: Resting heart rate at or above 70 bpm
requirements.policy_text: The approved resting heart rate is 70 beats per minute or higher.
requirements.provenance_note: The FDA prescribing information specifies a resting heart rate of at least 70 beats per minute for the adult indication.

criterion_sources.title: CORLANOR (ivabradine) prescribing information
criterion_sources.organization: U.S. National Library of Medicine DailyMed

requirements.title: Beta-blocker dose status
requirements.policy_text: The approved record documents a maximally tolerated beta-blocker dose, a contraindication, or intolerance.
requirements.provenance_note: The FDA prescribing information specifies maximally tolerated beta-blocker doses or a contraindication to beta-blocker use. The demo also accepts documented intolerance as review-ready evidence.

criterion_sources.title: CORLANOR (ivabradine) prescribing information
criterion_sources.organization: U.S. National Library of Medicine DailyMed

requirements.title: Blood pressure at or above 90/50 mmHg
requirements.policy_text: The approved blood pressure is at or above 90/50 mmHg.
requirements.provenance_note: The current FDA prescribing information lists clinically significant hypotension as a contraindication but does not state this numeric cutoff. The demo retains 90/50 only to preserve the existing deterministic scenario and does not present it as current clinical or coverage policy.
